title: CONTROL_ENV_NAMES (environment variables no child may inherit)
description: A security contract, not an implementation detail: these eleven names carry authority over the control plane or the gateway and are removed from every child process the bridge starts. Exactly these eleven in this revision of v1 (the three JAROD_OS_ names were added on 2026-10-19 by the Jarod-OS rename; the older names stay, since removing one is forbidden); adding one is additive (a new revision of this file), removing one is forbidden. The Python constant and this schema must name the same set (cross-checked by a test).
